fixture.about: A test city (#42): a city in balance, with no ballot measure, that budgets one year at a time. It borrows Berkeley's budget data so the pages that need it have something to show; its settings and reserves are its own.

reason.text: The City closed its structural deficit with ongoing reductions.

cites.quote: The City closed the FY 27 and FY 28 structural deficits with more than 10 percent in ongoing reductions.
